## Spatial Data Quality Toolkit

A small, focused suite for checking geospatial data before you trust
it. Free, no account, nothing ever leaves your browser.

**Inspect** → **Validate** → **Check Topology** → *CRS Inspector
(planned)*

Three are live so far — Inspect, Validate geometry, and Check
Topology. The CRS Inspector & Converter is next.
